title: Balanced College List Builder
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Build a college list of eight to twelve schools across reach, target, and safety, and check live whether it is balanced and includes an affordable safety you'd be glad to attend.

learningObjectives: Students will construct a balanced college list of eight to twelve schools and design it so that at least one affordable college they'd be glad to attend is very likely to admit them.

controls: Remove selected, Move left, and Move right buttons
Two Priya preset buttons and Clear

keyQuestions: Why must at least one safety be both affordable and a place you'd be glad to attend?
What makes a list with seven reaches risky, even for a strong student?
Why is 'Not checked' treated as a warning?
commonMisconceptions: Applying to more reaches raises your chances of a good outcome.
Any college likely to admit you counts as a safety.
assessmentOpportunities: Students build a list that passes every check and name their safest good outcome.
